title: Adopt a global-core, national-extension policy for standards and profiles
requirements:
- Require schema extensions to follow a governed national process with definitions, bindings and conformance
- Keep the shared core minimal and reach national needs by governed extension
- Direct countries to reuse international standards and IHE profiles first and limit national specifications to extensions
- Acknowledge the role of regional profiles, implementation guides and communities of practice
- Target unmanaged variation rather than variation itself
- State the global-core, national-extension approach in the summary, principles, 3.6.2 and 4.3
- Make governance mandatory even where a dedicated LIMR platform is optional
- Let countries adopt existing models and define only necessary constraints and mappings
